_readme: Atmosphere, clothing state, and expression wording snippets used by js/logic/prompts.js.

scenes.pov: first-person viewer perspective, intimate close framing, moody warm shadows
scenes.class: refined dark academia atmosphere, crisp architectural detail
scenes.club: luxurious neon-noir nightclub atmosphere, rich indigo and amber lighting
scenes.private: visceral intimate framing, dramatic chiaroscuro candlelight
scenes.rest: soft moonlight, quiet stillness, warm fabrics

clothing.partial: wearing {outfit}, clothing loosened and askew, revealing {underwear} underneath
clothing.partial_tease: wearing {outfit}, slipped off one shoulder with the hem raised teasingly over {underwear}
clothing.under_tease: wearing only {underwear}, her discarded {outfit} draped nearby

expressions.Fail: tense, overwhelmed expression, averted eyes, stiff posture
expressions.Good: flushed cheeks, parted lips, eager heated gaze
expressions.Excellent: deeply flushed face, glazed half-lidded eyes, breathless parted lips
expressions.eager: warm flushed smile, bright attentive eyes
expressions.defiant: sharp, guarded gaze, chin lifted slightly
expressions.alluring: soft sultry smirk, lingering eye contact
